title: A Landmark
subtitle: Size 64, and nothing else on the road is
description: The largest node on the road, at size 64, and the only one that is not
really a stop -- it is a thing you can see from the next three.
A size is just a number between 16 and 512. Nothing stops a chapter
drawing one node half the canvas wide; the bound exists so a typo of
6400 fails at load instead of at draw time.
